description: Lists the public items of the OSNT.IN daily briefs from the last 14 days (the first three of each brief, as a signed-out reader sees them; every item with an OSNT.IN Pro key), newest first: each item's title, date, every source it cites (name and link) and its page on app.osnt.in. No item text: open the link to read it. We attribute, we don't verify. Each item reports what its sources say. Free use requires naming OSNT.IN with a link (https://www.osnt.in or the item's own link).
name: list_recent_items
title: Recent OSNT.IN items
